patch.value: Expose conflicting verdict witnesses without voting them away

AC1: Opposed explicit fix and refuse judgments on one confirmed finding lineage and exact artifact scope yield both source identities in a bounded read-only decision packet. AC2: Provider counts and decision recency never settle conflict. AC3: Withdrawn or unavailable reviews cannot settle conflict. AC4: Typed SDK and CLI share strict validation, compact JSON/TOON, typed remedies, docs, model-based and no-git evidence, public tracker measurements and passing CI npm/Bun release gates. Overlap rechecked against pinned core SDK declarations and sibling pm-web: findingLineage/lineageGroups supply confirmed finding identity; core PmClient.planDecision and native Plan decisions remain authoritative; pm-web decision inbox owns human request/response. This feature only projects review-specific incompatible judgments and missing resolution evidence; it adds no persistence, vote aggregation, import, sync, journal or resolution workflow.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: reuse lineageGroups, complete native SDK reads, requestSnapshot verified history addressing and scopeDigest; command uses host-injected PmClient. Exact scope is GitHub repo/PR/revision or envelope origin/subject/revision. Only explicit fix versus refuse are opposed; pending, stale, duplicate and informational do not imply rejection. Read-only packets preserve all raw current judgments, including withdrawn sources, and mark missing core decision, resolution evidence and availability. No tracker mutations, leases, journal, import/export/sync or ambient create defaults are added. Tests will exercise SDK read-back, seeded 500-sequence replay/relationship changes, custom statuses, extreme metadata, every read boundary, packed installers and public non-git input fingerprints.
